description: Grade every MCP server in an MCP config. With no arguments, reads the usual config files on this machine (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf). Or pass `client` for one app, `path` for one file, or `config` with the JSON text. The file is read locally; only package names, image names and server URLs (no query strings) are sent to TrustedMCP. Env vars, headers, tokens and file paths never leave the machine.

client.description: Only this app: claude_desktop, claude_code, cursor, vscode or windsurf

config.description: The config JSON itself, e.g. the contents of claude_desktop_config.json

path.description: Path to one .json or .jsonc MCP config file

name: check_config
title: Check an MCP config
